newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican foreign minister denies coat was pinched.
newsitem.headline: Mexican foreign minister denies coat was pinched.

text.p: The great coat caper apparently was a myth.
Mexican Foreign Minister Jose Angel Gurria on Tuesday denied that a fine gabardine raincoat belonging to him was stolen in Bogota, Colombia, while he was giving a news conference last week.

The Colombian newspaper El Tiempo reported on Sunday that an unknown thief brazenly lifted the coat while it was hanging out to dry in the Colombian foreign ministry, and the report was reprinted by international agencies, including Reuters.
"I didn't take my raincoat to Bogota," Gurria told reporters on Tuesday.
Gurria said he called his Colombian counterpart, Maria Emma Mejia, to clarify that he was no crime victim.
"The only thing we received in Colombia was attention and hospitality," Gurria said.
